tokens.@FILTERS: Candidate filters: number of output channels for this Conv2D layer.
tokens.@ACTIVATION: Candidate activation name for the convolution.
tokens.@POOL_TYPE: Candidate pool_type: max selects MaxPooling2D; average selects AveragePooling2D.
tokens.@POOL_SIZE: Candidate pool_size used for both pooling dimensions.
tokens.@input_0: Input Keras tensor from the previous pipeline step.
tokens.@output_0: Output Keras tensor after convolution and pooling.
